title: Open Values Design Tokens v0.1
description: The colours, type sizes, spacing, motion rules and small drawings that give an Open Values site its look, grouped into one profile per site. Designers edit it by hand, and a build script turns it into the design token index and the custom properties in the app stylesheet.

format.description: Names the file format. Always open-values-design-tokens.

version.description: The version of this format the file follows. Currently 0.1.0.

standard.description: The standard this file belongs to. Always open-values-standard.

updated.description: The date the tokens were last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

purpose.description: A sentence saying what the token set is for.

principles.description: Short design rules every profile in the file follows, such as that contrast is computed rather than asserted.

references.description: Outside documents the tokens rely on, such as the WCAG contrast rules.

valueBloom.description: Colours and rules for the value bloom, the small flower drawing that shows how one option scores on each of the eight value themes.

cssVariableMapping.description: A review table that says which CSS custom property in the app each design token should set.

contrastRemediationContract.description: A checklist of known colour contrast failures in the app's stylesheet and how the app should fix each one. The tokens file supplies the colours and warnings; the fix itself is made in app/styles.css.

profiles.description: The skins in this file, one per site or look, each with a full set of tokens.

asof.description: The year the document was checked, as four digits.

value.description: The colour as a six-digit hex code, such as #1D7A5A.

role.description: What the colour is used for, such as primary text or focus ring.

aliases.description: Short colour names the app's stylesheet uses, such as bg, ink and accent, each mapped to a hex colour for this mode. At least four.

contrastPairs.description: Text and background combinations in this mode that must meet a minimum contrast. The audit computes each ratio from the alias colours.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the pair, such as ink-on-bg.

fg.description: The alias name of the text colour.

bg.description: The alias name of the background colour.

minimum.description: The lowest contrast ratio allowed, at least 3. WCAG asks for 4.5 for normal text and 3 for large text and interface parts.

status.description: A marker for this section's stage. The audit expects h1-pilot.

pilotColors.description: The colour tokens whose light-mode values must equal the matching light aliases: background, surface, surfaceAlt, text and accent.

light.description: Colours and contrast checks for light mode.

dark.description: Colours and contrast checks for dark mode.

status.description: A fixed marker for this section. Always h2-token-substrate.

consumer.description: The part of the app meant to use these colours, the App H2 day-cycle skin pass.

defaultMode.description: The variant used when none is chosen. Always noon.

variants.description: Four palettes for different times of day: dawn, noon, dusk and night. Noon matches light mode and night matches dark mode.

dawn.description: A warm palette for the start of the day.

noon.description: The ordinary light palette. Its colours match light mode.

dusk.description: A low-glare palette for the evening.

night.description: The dark palette. Its colours match dark mode.

mustNot.description: Things the app must not do with day-cycle colours, each starting Do not.

label.description: The variant's display name, such as Dawn.

role.description: When and why this palette is used, in a phrase.

aliases.description: Short colour names the stylesheet uses, such as bg, ink and accent, each mapped to a hex colour for this variant.

contrastPairs.description: Text and background combinations in this variant that must meet a minimum contrast.

status.description: A fixed marker for this section. Always h4-token-substrate.

consumer.description: The part of the app meant to draw the bloom, the App H4 values-bloom card.

sourceFunction.description: The engine function that computes the scores the bloom draws, CC.engine.signature.

minimumThemesForBloom.description: How many themes an option needs scores for before a bloom is drawn. Currently 2.

scoreScale.description: How the scores are read: a 0 to 100 average per theme, with themes that have no data left out rather than set to 0.

order.description: The eight theme ids in the order their petals are drawn.

themes.description: The eight value themes, each with its petal and centre colours.

signatureVector.description: Rules for storing an option's theme scores as a valueSignature field, if a dataset chooses to store them.

id.description: The theme's id, such as planet or privacy.

universal.description: The matching theme in the vocabulary shared across Open Values sites, such as wellbeing for health.

petalColor.description: The petal colour for this theme, as a hex code.

centerColor.description: The colour of the petal's centre for this theme, as a hex code.

role.description: What the theme covers, in a phrase.

status.description: A fixed marker saying storing the vector is optional. Always optional-materialization-contract.

field.description: The name of the field that holds the scores on an option. Always valueSignature.

order.description: The eight theme ids in order. Must match the bloom order.

shape.description: A sentence describing how the stored object is laid out.

omitMissing.description: Always true: a theme with no data is left out of the object, never stored as 0.

mustNot.description: Things a dataset must not do when storing scores, each starting Do not.

family.description: The CSS font-family list for this text style.

size.description: The font size, in rem or px.

lineHeight.description: The line height as a multiple of the font size.

status.description: A fixed marker for this section. Always h3-token-substrate.

consumer.description: The part of the app meant to use these motion rules, the App H3 motion skin pass.

durationFast.description: The shortest animation length, in milliseconds, 0 to 150.

durationBase.description: The ordinary animation length, in milliseconds, 0 to 150. Not shorter than durationFast.

durationSlow.description: The longest ordinary animation length, in milliseconds, 0 to 150. Not shorter than durationBase.

durationRerank.description: How long the animation takes when a ranked list reorders, in milliseconds, 200 to 500. It is the one longer duration allowed.

reducedMotion.description: What happens when the reader has asked their device for reduced motion, such as opacity-or-instant.

maxMovingElements.description: The most elements allowed to move at once, up to 16.

curves.description: Named CSS easing curves, such as breathe and settle, each a cubic-bezier value.

settleDurations.description: Named animation lengths in milliseconds, such as micro, hover, reveal, rerank and bloom, in rising order.

intents.description: The kinds of motion the app may use, such as hover feedback, each with its limits.

reducedMotionPolicy.description: What motion is still allowed when the reader asks for reduced motion.

mustNot.description: Things the app must not do with motion, such as animating rankings to create urgency.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the kind of motion, such as hover-feedback.

duration.description: The name of the duration to use, a key in settleDurations.

curve.description: The name of the easing curve to use, a key in curves.

maxDistancePx.description: The furthest an element may move, in pixels, 0 to 24.

maxMovingElements.description: The most elements allowed to move at once for this kind of motion. Not more than the profile's maxMovingElements.

allowedProperties.description: The CSS properties this motion may animate, such as opacity or color.

mustNot.description: Things this kind of motion must not do.

mode.description: The reduced-motion approach. Must match the motion section's reducedMotion value.

allowedProperties.description: The CSS properties that may still change under reduced motion. Transform is not allowed.

mustNot.description: Things the app must not do under reduced motion, such as removing information.

status.description: A fixed marker for this section. Always h5-token-substrate.

consumer.description: The part of the app meant to use these surface rules, the App H5 materiality skin pass.

paperGrain.description: Settings for the faint paper texture on page surfaces.

shadow.description: Rules for shadows on raised surfaces.

surfaces.description: The surfaces that carry the paper texture, each tied to a colour token.

opacity.description: How visible the texture is, above 0 and at most 0.08.

scalePx.description: The size of the texture tile in pixels, 96 to 320.

contrastLimit.description: The most the texture may change contrast, above 0 and at most 0.1.

tokens.description: Names of the colour tokens the texture may sit on, such as background and surface.

mustNot.description: Things the texture must not do, such as hiding low contrast or animating.

source.description: Where the shadow values come from. Always tokens.elevation.

maxLevels.description: How many shadow levels may be used, 1 or 2.

mustNot.description: Things shadows must not do, such as serving as the only focus indicator.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the surface, such as page-paper.

token.description: The name of the colour token for this surface. It must exist in the profile's colours.

role.description: Where the surface is used, in a phrase.

status.description: A fixed marker for this table. Always i3-review-table.

consumer.description: The part of the app meant to apply the mapping.

sourceProfile.description: The id of the profile whose tokens the table maps, such as quiet-commons.

note.description: A sentence on who owns which side of the mapping.

rows.description: One row per CSS custom property.

token.description: The token's path in the profile, with dots, such as color.background.

cssVariable.description: The CSS custom property the token sets, such as --bg.

role.description: What the property is used for, in a phrase.

status.description: A fixed marker for this checklist. Always h9-app-owned-remediation.

consumer.description: The part of the app meant to make the fixes, the App H9 contrast cleanup.

sourceAudit.description: The audit that finds the contrast failures. Always research/contrast_audit.js.

appOwnedFile.description: The file where the fixes are made. Always app/styles.css.

rule.description: A sentence saying the tokens file supplies tokens and warnings and the app makes the CSS change.

sharedEvidenceRequired.description: Checks to run after the fixes, such as running the contrast audit.

coverage.description: Totals for the checklist: warnings, steps, the CSS variable that must be added (--accent-text), and flags saying the fix is made in the app (appOwned true) and cannot be made in the data alone (dataOnlyFix false).

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the step.

label.description: What to do, in a short phrase.

warning.description: The contrast failure the audit reported, with the measured ratio.

theme.description: Which theme the failure is in: light or dark.

foreground.description: The text colour that fails, as a hex code or CSS variable.

background.description: The background it fails on, as a hex code or CSS variable.

minimum.description: The ratio it must reach. Currently 4.5 for every step.

targetCssVariables.description: The CSS custom properties the fix should use or change.

tokenSource.description: The design token that supplies the fixed colour, such as color.accentText.

appOwnedEvidence.description: What the app must show once the step is done.

mustNot.description: Ways the fix must not be made.

color.description: The named colours, at least eight, each with a hex value and a role. The audit requires the twelve core ones, such as background, text, accent and focus, and at least four hue groups.

colorRamps.description: Families of related shades, such as leaf and water, each mapping numbered stops (lighter numbers are lighter) to hex colours.

colorModes.description: Light and dark mode colours with their contrast checks.

dayCycle.description: Palettes for dawn, noon, dusk and night.

typography.description: Text styles, such as display, heading and body, each with a font family, size and line height.

space.description: Named spacing sizes, such as sm and lg, in rem or px.

radius.description: Named corner radii, such as card and pill, in rem or px.

elevation.description: One or two shadow levels, named level1 and level2, as CSS box-shadow values.

materiality.description: Paper texture and shadow rules for surfaces.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the pair, unique in the profile.

fg.description: The name of the text colour token.

bg.description: The name of the background colour token.

purpose.description: What the pair is used for, such as normal-text.

minimum.description: The lowest contrast ratio allowed, at least 3. The audit computes the real ratio from the two colours and fails if it is lower.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the component, such as ranked-card.

tokens.description: Names of the colour tokens the component uses.

mustExpress.description: What the component must show, such as the fit tier or source access.

mustNot.description: What the component must not do or look like, such as look sponsored.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the drawing.

kind.description: svg-line for a stroked line drawing, svg-fill for a filled shape.

viewBox.description: The SVG viewBox, as four numbers.

stroke.description: The colour token used for the line, or none.

fill.description: The colour token used for the fill, or none.

path.description: The SVG path data, starting with M.

usage.description: Where the drawing may be used, in a phrase.

id.description: A lowercase hyphenated id for the profile, such as quiet-commons.

role.description: Which site or use the profile is for, as a short id.

status.description: How far along the profile is: format-seed (an example to build from), active, or archived.

tokens.description: The profile's design tokens: colours, type, spacing, corners, motion and shadows.

contrastPairs.description: Text and background combinations that must meet a minimum contrast. At least six.

componentContracts.description: Rules for what key components must and must not show. At least two.

artTokens.description: Small SVG drawings the skin may use, such as section dividers. At least two.
